source_path.fact: Gemma4ForCausalLM.forward supplies auxiliary states to LogitsProcessor only while capture_aux_hidden_states is true.
The pinned implementation sets capture_aux_hidden_states and layers_to_capture at the model runtime boundary for its own layer-capture API.
When layers_to_capture is populated, Gemma4Model returns the requested auxiliary states with the final hidden state.

localized_defect: The bootstrap set capture flags only in __init__; the observed logits boundary still had no auxiliary states, so a later runtime transition reset or replaced those flags before request forwards.
repair: Set the same pinned capture flags immediately before every Gemma4ForCausalLM.forward call. This is a hook lifecycle change only; the workload, split, model weights, capture layers, training, holdout, and endpoint closure are unchanged.
